statements.statement: The service provided was mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229)
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with a recent transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The patient has concurrent nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency raises concern for potential cardioembolic sources
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias
The denial was based on missing prior authorization
